semiconductor_relevance: High - Juztech specializes in vacuum equipment that is critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HangZhou Jiuzheng Technology Co., LTD, known as Juztech, is a high-tech enterprise focused on R&D and manufacturing of dry oil-free vacuum equipment. Their products are widely used in the semiconductor industry, among others, providing efficient and stable vacuum solutions.

regional_presence.China: Juztech is headquartered in Hangzhou, China, with a production base of over 30,000 square meters.
